import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species case variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'adelie': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island label variants (typos)
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    # Convert text-written numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def answer(df):
    counts = df['island'].value_counts()
    return counts.to_dict()
